translation: Also, dog-bone ash (狗骨灰) treats dysentery (下痢), produces flesh (生肌), and is applied to horse-sores (馬瘡). Black-dog blood (烏狗血) treats difficult labor with transverse birth (產難橫生) and blood surging upward to stir the heart (血上蕩心). The original text of the Benjing: Mugou yinjing (牡狗陰莖), salty in flavor, neutral.
